svg.title: The field menu's layers
svg.desc: The field menu open in Vale at the Sanctum's door, as the player sees it, comes apart into the six sheets the console stacks to draw it, then closes again. The map stays as it was: the ground on BG3, the middle layer on BG2, Isaac as a sprite level with it, and the overhead layer on BG1. In front of them the menu adds two sheets: its windows on BG0, the party's HP and PP and the name of the chosen command, and its command icons as sprites at the front priority.
svg.text: THE FIELD MENU, AS THE PLAYER SEES IT
